result.summary: The layout is mostly coherent, but there are several visual defects: a spelling error in the search placeholder, truncated text in the horizontal carousel without proper truncation styling, inconsistent card/thumbnail and favorite-button styling, and content clipped at the viewport edges.

issues.description: Search field placeholder is misspelled: 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' should be 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third card's title is hard-cut at the screen edge ('Trattoria Piccol') with no ellipsis and the card image is clipped, making it look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add an ellipsis/text-overflow rule to card titles and use consistent horizontal padding plus a partially visible card with a fade or peek so it reads as a scrollable carousel.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are inconsistent: the Tokumaru Ramen card uses a white circular button while the pizza card below uses a dark/transparent circle, so the same control looks different between cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button background, border and icon color across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: The first 'Fastest near you' thumbnail (Green Bowl Poké) has a flat light-grey background while sibling thumbnails use dark photographic backgrounds, making the row look visually inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent image treatment (same aspect ratio, background and overlay) for all carousel thumbnails, or add a neutral placeholder style applied to all cards.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped mid-chip at the right edge with no fade or partial-visibility cue, so the cut-off pill looks like a rendering error.
issues.suggestion: Add trailing padding and a gradient fade or peek offset to indicate the chips scroll horizontally.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is cut off by the bottom tab bar with no visible title, rating or bottom spacing, so the list appears to end abruptly.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding equal to the tab bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: Cards in 'Fastest near you' show delivery time and fee but no rating, while 'Popular right now' cards show ratings — inconsistent metadata across similar card types.
issues.suggestion: Display the same core metadata (rating, ETA, fee) on all restaurant cards or intentionally define distinct card variants.
